ns2:section.sectionText: 2 or 4 hours (be sure to enroll in your desired amount of credit). Meets the last two weeks of SS1: Tuesday-Friday, June 1-June 4, and Monday-Friday, June 7-June 11. (The final fee amount could change depending on course enrollment.) The student will also be responsible for one night's lodging and their meals. Contact the instructor (fschlipf@illinois.edu) with questions or for further details about the course.
